=== /workspace/.devcontainer/features/add-bin-path/devcontainer-feature.json ===
{
  "id": "add-bin-path",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "name": "Add Bin Path",
  "description": "Adds a custom bin path to the container environment.",
  "options": {
    "addBinPath": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "",
      "description": "The path to add to the container's PATH."
    }
  },
  "privileged": true
}=== /workspace/.devcontainer/features/add-bin-path/install.sh ===
#!/usr/bin/env sh

echo "export PATH=$ADDBINPATH:\$PATH" > /etc/profile.d/add_bin_path.sh=== /workspace/.devcontainer/features/zammad-deps/devcontainer-feature.json ===
{
  "id": "zammad-deps",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "name": "Zammad Dependency Installer",
  "description": "Installs dependencies required for Zammad.",
  "customizations": {
    "vscode": {
      "extensions": [
        "andyyaldoo.vscode-json",
        "anthropic.claude-code",
        "bradlc.vscode-tailwindcss",
        "dariofuzinato.vue-peek",
        "davidanson.vscode-markdownlint",
        "dbaeumer.vscode-eslint",
        "dotjoshjohnson.xml",
        "eamodio.gitlens",
        "ezforo.copy-relative-path-and-line-numbers",
        "jock.svg",
        "kaiwood.endwise",
        "mde.select-highlight-minimap",
        "oxc.oxc-vscode",
        "redhat.vscode-yaml",
        "shardulm94.trailing-spaces",
        "shopify.ruby-lsp",
        "slb235.vscode-coffeelint",
        "streetsidesoftware.code-spell-checker",
        "timonwong.shellcheck",
        "vitest.explorer",
        "vue.volar"
      ]
    }
  },
  "privileged": true,
  "installsAfter": ["ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/go"]
}
=== /workspace/.devcontainer/features/zammad-deps/install.sh ===
#!/usr/bin/env sh

export PATH="/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH"

go install github.com/ddollar/forego@master
